artifact: Issue #9 M4-3 write request envelope contract
representation: internal typed request; not a model-facing JSON payload
request_reuse_rule: Reuse PlanInitRequest and PlanRetirementRequest as operation-specific payloads; do not create duplicate intent, precondition, lease, project binding, snapshot, or result models.

common_fields.name: operation
common_fields.source: canonical descriptor lookup; caller value must agree

common_fields.name: store
common_fields.source: trusted internal construction only; never model input

operation_payloads.required_exact_decision: Project Binding must already be selected and validated; relationship evidence alone is not a binding.
The exact candidate snapshot, explicit retirement kind, and any exact successor must be supplied; ingress never selects them.

semantic_intent_owned_by_external_actor: successor selection represented by exact successor_ref
derived_by_ingress: actual authority source and digest bindings from request preconditions
correlation id bounded by the existing ingress helper
never_model_asserted: internal IDs and typed ObjectRef values
authority source revision or raw digest

construction_rules: Reject a plain dict on the write entry point; adapters must construct the typed envelope through a trusted boundary.
Reject any request whose payload operation, intent operation, descriptor operation, or lease operation differs.
Use actual request fields to build validation inputs; never copy request bindings from the lease.
Do not permit MutationIntent semantic_inputs to contain trusted keys already blocked by M4-1.
Do not infer a typed target from a string, candidate list, current pointer, or resolver ordering.
Do not accept a lease reference that has not been resolved to the typed CapabilityLease before dispatch.
